verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Alloy offers ongoing monitoring: scheduled Portfolio workflows, perpetual KYC/AML and continuous portfolio risk signals. Nothing documents a compliance officer turning ongoing screening on or off for selected customers. The only documented 'enable' applies Source Workflows to whole event types, not to individual customers, so it is an adjacent control that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers
